description: Shell script for checking authentication status for Claude Code and OpenClaw, providing detailed status reports and handling various output modes.

methods.name: fetch_models_status_json
methods.description: Fetches the status JSON from openclaw models CLI command.

methods.name: calc_status_from_expires
methods.description: Calculates the status ('MISSING', 'EXPIRED', 'EXPIRING', 'OK') based on expiration timestamp.

methods.name: json_expires_for_claude_cli
methods.description: Extracts the expiration timestamp for Claude via JSON output.

methods.name: json_expires_for_anthropic_any
methods.description: Extracts the maximum expiration timestamp for any anthropic profile.

methods.name: json_best_anthropic_profile
methods.description: Selects the profile ID with the latest expiration timestamp.

methods.name: json_anthropic_api_key_count
methods.description: Counts the number of API keys for the anthropic provider.

methods.name: check_claude_code_auth
methods.description: Checks the current Claude code authentication status.

methods.name: check_openclaw_auth
methods.description: Checks the current OpenClaw authentication status.
